pattern: {p:Player} sacrifice[s] {n:Qty} {f:Filter} of their choice , then gain[s] life equal to that creature 's toughness
subject: player

examples.text: Target opponent sacrifices an artifact creature of their choice, then gains life equal to that creature's toughness.
Target player sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice, then gains life equal to that creature's toughness.

counterExamples: Target player sacrifices a creature of their choice, then gains life equal to that creature's power.
Target player sacrifices a creature of their choice, then you gain life equal to that creature's toughness.
Target player sacrifices a creature, then gains life equal to that creature's toughness.

pattern: {o:Obj} (has | have) {a:Abilities} as long as its controller controls another creature

examples.text: Enchanted creature has shroud as long as its controller controls another creature.
Enchanted creature has hexproof as long as its controller controls another creature.

counterExamples: Enchanted creature has shroud as long as you control another creature.
Enchanted creature has shroud as long as its controller controls a creature.
Enchanted creature has shroud as long as its controller controls another artifact.

pattern: as long as {o:Obj} is attacking , defending player can't cast spells

examples.text: As long as this artifact is attacking, defending player can't cast spells.
As long as enchanted creature is attacking, defending player can't cast spells.

counterExamples: As long as it's your turn, defending player can't cast spells.
As long as you control a Dragon, defending player can't cast spells.
As long as ~ is attacking, defending player can't cast creature spells.
As long as ~ is attacking, each opponent can't cast spells.
As long as ~ is attacking, defending player can't activate abilities.
As long as this artifact is attacking alone, defending player can't cast spells.

pattern: whenever a spell or ability causes a player to shuffle their library

examples.text: Whenever a spell or ability causes a player to shuffle their library, ~ deals 3 damage to that player.
Whenever a spell or ability causes a player to shuffle their library, you gain 1 life.

counterExamples: Whenever a spell or ability causes an opponent to shuffle their library, ~ deals 2 damage to that player.
Whenever a spell or ability causes a player to shuffle their graveyard, ~ deals 2 damage to that player.
Whenever a spell causes a player to shuffle their library, ~ deals 2 damage to that player.
